stemMd: A salesperson earns 4% commission on the first 5000 units of monthly sales and 6% on sales above 5000. What commission is earned on 8000 units of sales?
explanationMd: The first bracket gives 0.04 times 5000=200. The remaining 3000 gives 180. Total commission is 380; progressive brackets must be calculated separately.

distractorRationale.d: This averages rates without the correct bracket amounts.
distractorRationale.a: This counts only the excess-sales commission.
